Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

Closes #1574

blocks.text:
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. - Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **<NUMBERS>**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer; AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after one `fa update` the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a reinstall writes the correct layout directly. Stale `~/.local/bin/lib` leftovers migrate away (moved, not duplicated) on the heal.

blocks.text:
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

{"content":"## Thread: one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary does not heal the layout (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL6C`)

Addressed with the **successor-side layout repair** option, so one `fa update` now suffices:

- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart` — new `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout()`: on the bundled library's first failed load, if `<exe_dir>/lib/` still carries `libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population every pre-fix installer created) and the resolver's `<exe_dir>/../lib/` does not have them, they are **moved** (not copied) into place and the load is retried once. A non-load error on the retried load still passes through untouched; the repair is best-effort (never throws, never clobbers an existing file at the target, touches only `libsqlite3.*` names so a dev run's Dart-VM directories are never disturbed). `Sqlite3Engine` gained a `layoutRepair` test seam (stub parity kept for the conditional export).

  Placement rationale: lazily at the point of symptom instead of on boot — zero cost on healthy installs, and the healing turns into a *successful read* rather than an advice note. It heals every pre-fix population: reinstall (new installer layout), one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary (old copy code re-creates `bin/lib`, the new binary migrates it away on the first SQLite read), and even a pre-fix install whose user swaps the binary manually. A pre-fix binary alone still shows the old raw error — code can't repair what isn't shipped — which is exactly the window this closes.

- PR description — corrected: the "heal on the next reinstall **or `fa update`**" claim is replaced with the accurate story above (one update + first SQLite read self-heals; a pre-fix binary cannot repair itself).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — wording extended with the self-heal sentence and the stale-leftover migration.

Tests (`test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart`, new `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group, 8 tests): stale migration moves `libsqlite3.*` into `<exe_dir>/../lib` and leaves unrelated files; no-op when no stale dir; never clobbers a lib already at the target; missing executable is a no-op; engine retries after a successful repair; still degrades to the clean note when the repair doesn't heal; no second load attempt when the repair is a no-op; non-load retry failures pass through.

blocks.text:
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.

- **3 open review threads addressed** (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL2-`, `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL6C`, `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL8x`); the three `threadId: null` entries in `pr_discussions_raw.json` (automated-review record, review-verdict marker, rework-consume marker) are machine notices marked "please do not edit or reply" — no reply targets exist for them, so `review_replies.json` carries the 3 real threads.
- **No merge conflicts**: `origin/main` had moved again (gh-1579 verifier-integrity gate); the in-progress sync merge found staged in this checkout was verified complete (`git ls-files -u` empty) and concluded (`8dbd28b96`), keeping the branch a strict superset of `main`.
- **Extra defect found and fixed while applying thread 3**: `site/install.sh` is GENERATED from `site/install.sh.template` (`dart run scripts/gen_installers.dart`), but the original gh-1574 fix had only been hand-patched into the generated file — the template still had the broken `<install_dir>/lib` layout and the swallowed lib copy, so any installer regeneration would have resurrected the bug. The template now carries the fix and `site/install.sh` was regenerated from it (diff vs the hand-patched installer: only the intended loud-copy hunk).
- No CI failures at rework start (`ci_failures.md`: all checks green).

## Approach

1. **Thread 1 (wrong example path `~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib`)** — corrected to `~/.local/lib/libsqlite3.dylib` in all four places: `sqliteUnavailableMessage` (`lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite_reader.dart`), the `_macMissingDylibError` fixture (`test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart`), the `CHANGELOG.md` error quote, and the PR description. Added regression pins: the note must contain the `/lib/` shape and not the old one; the fixtures must mirror the real resolver paths.
2. **Thread 2 (one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary doesn't heal)** — implemented the successor-side layout repair: `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` (`lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`) runs on the first failed bundled-library load, moves stale `<exe_dir>/lib/libsqlite3.*` into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` (never clobbering an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only so dev/pub runs can't touch foreign directories) and retries the load once — so the **first SQLite read on the updated binary heals the install**, closing the two-update window. Non-load errors on the retry still pass through untouched; the repair is best-effort (never throws). Placed at the point of symptom rather than on boot: zero cost on healthy installs, and the heal becomes a successful read instead of an advice note. Corrected the overstated healing claim in the PR description and extended the CHANGELOG wording.
3. **Thread 3 (swallowed lib-copy failures)** — `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` now warn (naming the lib dir) instead of `2>/dev/null || true`; applied in the template + regenerated the installer; added static-contract tests forbidding `|| true`/`2>/dev/null` on the lib-copy line and requiring the warning, plus a template-drift guard.
4. TDD throughout: tests written first (RED confirmed for the installer contracts; compile-error RED for the engine group), then implementation (GREEN), then the full-suite run.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite_reader.dart` — note example path fix.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart` — `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` + `layoutRepair` seam + retry-after-repair in `openReadOnly`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart` — constructor/API parity for the conditional export (analyzer resolves the web stub).
- `site/install.sh.template` — `../lib` layout, loud lib copy, xattr `$lib_dir`, source-build advice line (regen source of truth).
- `site/install.sh` — regenerated from the template.
- `install_local.sh` — loud lib copy.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — error-quote path fix; self-heal + loud-copy wording.
- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — fixture path fix; `/lib/`-shape pins; new 8-test self-heal group.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — installer-contract extensions (no-swallow + template drift guard).
- PR description updated via `gh pr edit` (root-cause quote, healing claim, new fix bullets, test numbers).

## Test Coverage

- New/extended regression tests: 8 engine self-heal tests + 2 note/fixture path pins + 2 installer contracts (no-swallow, template drift guard) — all written to fail before the fix.
- Targeted suites: `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` + `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — **97 passed** (up from 85).
- Full CI pre-merge scope (`dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **FULL_SUITE_LINE**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): AC1/AC2/AC3 + contract1 pass; the pre-existing `contract1b` "marker resolution not logged" failure reproduces identically with the regenerated installer (that code path is byte-identical, line 162 — environment-specific, documented in the original PR description).
- `dart analyze` clean on all changed files; `dart format` clean.

blocks.text:
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).

The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.

{"content":"Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/lib/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (with the swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix (layout, loud lib copy, advice line) and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/lib/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing file at the target, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout itself; a non-load error on the retried load still passes through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` print a warning naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/lib/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. New `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group (8 tests): stale migration into `<exe_dir>/../lib`, no-op / no-clobber / missing-exe guards, engine retry after a successful repair, clean-note degradation when the repair does not heal, and pass-through for non-load retry errors.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, **`site/install.sh.template`** (regen-drift guard), and `site/install.ps1`; the POSIX lib-copy lines must not swallow failures (`|| true` / `2>/dev/null` forbidden, a warning naming the lib dir required).
- Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **FULL_SUITE_NUMBERS**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer (the marker-resolution code path is byte-identical, line 162); AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass. Environment-specific, not touched by this fix.

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after **one `fa update`** the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a **reinstall** writes the correct layout directly. A **pre-fix binary cannot repair itself** (the old code ships no repair): its update swaps in the fixed binary but re-copies the libs to the old place — the self-heal above closes exactly that window, so the repair story no longer needs a second update.

blocks.text:
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines).
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — new `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, and `site/install.ps1`.
- Targeted suites: 85 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`), all previously failing repro tests now green.
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **10,547 passed, 10 skipped** (environment-gated live legs), **0 failures**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — one pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure reproduces identically on the base commit (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal on the next reinstall or `fa update` (both now write the correct layout). Stale libs at `~/.local/bin/lib` are inert leftovers; nothing reads them.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

{"content":"## Thread: one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary does not heal the layout (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL6C`)

Addressed with the **successor-side layout repair** option, so one `fa update` now suffices:

- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart` — new `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout()`: on the bundled library's first failed load, if `<exe_dir>/lib/` still carries `libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population every pre-fix installer created) and the resolver's `<exe_dir>/../lib/` does not have them, they are **moved** (not copied) into place and the load is retried once. A non-load error on the retried load still passes through untouched; the repair is best-effort (never throws, never clobbers an existing file at the target, touches only `libsqlite3.*` names so a dev run's Dart-VM directories are never disturbed). `Sqlite3Engine` gained a `layoutRepair` test seam (stub parity kept for the conditional export).

  Placement rationale: lazily at the point of symptom instead of on boot — zero cost on healthy installs, and the healing turns into a *successful read* rather than an advice note. It heals every pre-fix population: reinstall (new installer layout), one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary (old copy code re-creates `bin/lib`, the new binary migrates it away on the first SQLite read), and even a pre-fix install whose user swaps the binary manually. A pre-fix binary alone still shows the old raw error — code can't repair what isn't shipped — which is exactly the window this closes.

- PR description — corrected: the "heal on the next reinstall **or `fa update`**" claim is replaced with the accurate story above (one update + first SQLite read self-heals; a pre-fix binary cannot repair itself).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — wording extended with the self-heal sentence and the stale-leftover migration.

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.

Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. New `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group (8 tests): stale migration into `<exe_dir>/../lib`, no-op/clobber/missing-exe guards, engine retry-after-repair, degraded-note and pass-through paths.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, **`site/install.sh.template`** (drift guard), and `site/install.ps1`; lib-copy lines must not swallow failures (`|| true`/`2>/dev/null` forbidden, warning naming the lib dir required).
- Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **<NUMBERS>**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer; AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after one `fa update` the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a reinstall writes the correct layout directly. A **pre-fix binary cannot repair itself** (the old code ships no repair), so its first update swaps in the fixed binary but re-copies libs to the old place — the self-heal above closes exactly that window. Stale `~/.local/bin/lib` leftovers migrate away (moved, not duplicated) on the heal.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. New `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group (8 tests): stale migration into `<exe_dir>/../lib`, no-op/clobber/missing-exe guards, engine retry-after-repair, degraded-note and pass-through paths.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, **`site/install.sh.template`** (drift guard), and `site/install.ps1`; lib-copy lines must not swallow failures (`|| true`/`2>/dev/null` forbidden, warning naming the lib dir required).
- Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **<NUMBERS>**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer; AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after one `fa update` the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a reinstall writes the correct layout directly. A **pre-fix binary cannot repair itself** (the old code ships no repair), so its first update swaps in the fixed binary but re-copies libs to the old place — the self-heal above closes exactly that window. Stale `~/.local/bin/lib` leftovers migrate away (moved, not duplicated) on the heal.

```
Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. New `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group (8 tests): stale migration into `<exe_dir>/../lib`, no-op/clobber/missing-exe guards, engine retry-after-repair, degraded-note and pass-through paths.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, **`site/install.sh.template`** (drift guard), and `site/install.ps1`; lib-copy lines must not swallow failures (`|| true`/`2>/dev/null` forbidden, warning naming the lib dir required).
- Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **<NUMBERS>**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer; AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass (environment-specific, not touched by this fix).

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after one `fa update` the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a reinstall writes the correct layout directly. A **pre-fix binary cannot repair itself** (the old code ships no repair), so its first update swaps in the fixed binary but re-copies libs to the old place — the self-heal above closes exactly that window. Stale `~/.local/bin/lib` leftovers migrate away (moved, not duplicated) on the heal.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

{"content":"Closes #1574
### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/lib/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (with the swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix (layout, loud lib copy, advice line) and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/lib/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing file at the target, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout itself; a non-load error on the retried load still passes through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` print a warning naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.

### Test Coverage

- `test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart` — `missing bundled library degrades cleanly (gh-1574)` group: load-failure classification (macOS + Linux error shapes), clean-note mapping through `openReadOnly` and through the `read` tool, non-load errors unclassified; plus correct-path pins for the note (`~/.local/lib/libsqlite3.dylib`) and the fixtures. New `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group (8 tests): stale migration into `<exe_dir>/../lib`, no-op / no-clobber / missing-exe guards, engine retry after a successful repair, clean-note degradation when the repair does not heal, and pass-through for non-load retry errors.
- `test/cli/self_manage_test.dart` — `copyBundleLibs` installs into `<installDir>/../lib` and never `<installDir>/lib`; static layout contract for `install_local.sh`, `site/install.sh`, **`site/install.sh.template`** (regen-drift guard), and `site/install.ps1`; the POSIX lib-copy lines must not swallow failures (`|| true` / `2>/dev/null` forbidden, a warning naming the lib dir required).
- Targeted suites: 97 tests passed (`sqlite_engine_test` + `self_manage_test`).
- Full suite (CI pre-merge scope: `dart test --exclude-tags integration,browser-ext`): **FULL_SUITE_NUMBERS**.
- `bash scripts/installer_verify_selftest.sh` (AC1–AC4): unchanged behavior — the pre-existing `contract1b` log-assertion failure ("marker resolution not logged") reproduces identically with the regenerated installer (the marker-resolution code path is byte-identical, line 162); AC1/AC2/AC3 and contract1 pass. Environment-specific, not touched by this fix.

### Notes

- Existing installs broken by the old layout heal in one step: after **one `fa update`** the new binary migrates the stale `bin/lib` libs on its first SQLite read and the read succeeds; a **reinstall** writes the correct layout directly. A **pre-fix binary cannot repair itself** (the old code ships no repair): its update swaps in the fixed binary but re-copies the libs to the old place — the self-heal above closes exactly that window, so the repair story no longer needs a second update.
- Windows `site/install.ps1` needed no change; its layout (`<root>\bin\fa.exe` + `<root>\lib`) already matches the native-assets lookup.
- Release archives are unchanged (`bundle/bin` + `bundle/lib`) — only install destinations moved.

**Thread 2 (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL6C` — one `fa update` doesn't heal)**: implemented the successor-side repair — `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` in `sqlite3_engine.dart` moves stale `<exe_dir>/lib/libsqlite3.*` into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` on the first failed load and retries once (best-effort, never clobbers, `libsqlite3.*`-names only, non-load errors pass through) — so the first SQLite read on the updated binary heals the install; one update suffices. New 8-test group + `layoutRepair` seam (+ web-stub API parity for the analyzer).

**Thread 3 (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL8x` — swallowed lib-copy failures)**: `site/install.sh` + `install_local.sh` now warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`. **Extra defect found**: `site/install.sh` is generated from `site/install.sh.template`, and the original fix had only been hand-patched into the generated file — the template still had the broken layout AND the swallowed copy, so regeneration would have resurrected gh-1574. {"content":"## Thread: one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary does not heal the layout (`PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6sDL6C`)

Addressed with the **successor-side layout repair** option, so one `fa update` now suffices:

- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart` — new `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout()`: on the bundled library's first failed load, if `<exe_dir>/lib/` still carries `libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population every pre-fix installer created) and the resolver's `<exe_dir>/../lib/` does not have them, they are **moved** (not copied) into place and the load is retried once. A non-load error on the retried load still passes through untouched; the repair is best-effort (never throws, never clobbers an existing file at the target, touches only `libsqlite3.*` names so a dev run's Dart-VM directories are never disturbed). `Sqlite3Engine` gained a `layoutRepair` test seam (stub parity kept for the conditional export).

  Placement rationale: lazily at the point of symptom instead of on boot — zero cost on healthy installs, and the healing turns into a *successful read* rather than an advice note. It heals every pre-fix population: reinstall (new installer layout), one `fa update` from a pre-fix binary (old copy code re-creates `bin/lib`, the new binary migrates it away on the first SQLite read), and even a pre-fix install whose user swaps the binary manually. A pre-fix binary alone still shows the old raw error — code can't repair what isn't shipped — which is exactly the window this closes.

- PR description — corrected: the "heal on the next reinstall **or `fa update`**" claim is replaced with the accurate story above (one update + first SQLite read self-heals; a pre-fix binary cannot repair itself).
- `CHANGELOG.md` — wording extended with the self-heal sentence and the stale-leftover migration.

Tests (`test/tools/sqlite_engine_test.dart`, new `successor-side layout repair (gh-1574 r2)` group, 8 tests): stale migration moves `libsqlite3.*` into `<exe_dir>/../lib` and leaves unrelated files; no-op when no stale dir; never clobbers a lib already at the target; missing executable is a no-op; engine retries after a successful repair; still degrades to the clean note when the repair doesn't heal; no second load attempt when the repair is a no-op; non-load retry failures pass through.

### Root Cause

`package:sqlite3` 3.x ships SQLite via Dart **native assets**: an AOT binary built with `dart build cli` resolves its bundled library at `<exe_dir>/../lib/<name>`. Every POSIX installer copied the libs beside the binary instead (`<install_dir>/lib`), so for `~/.local/bin/fa` the resolver looked in `~/.local/lib` and found nothing — the first `sqlite3_*` FFI call threw the raw `Couldn't resolve native function … Failed to load dynamic library '~/.local/libsqlite3.dylib'` error. Verified by relocating a real `dart build cli` bundle: `<exe_dir>/../lib` loads, the installer layout fails with exactly the reported error.

### Fix

- `site/install.sh`: copy bundle libs to `$install_dir/../lib` (also the macOS quarantine-xattr pass and the source-build advice lines). **Regenerated from `site/install.sh.template`** — the template had been left on the old layout (and the old swallowed lib copy), so regenerating the installers would have resurrected gh-1574; the template now carries the fix and the generated installer matches it.
- `install_local.sh`: same — `mkdir -p`/`cp -R` target `$INSTALL_DIR/../lib`.
- `bin/self_manage.dart`: `_copyBundleLibs` → public `copyBundleLibs`, targeting `<installDir>/../lib` (fixes `fa update`; also aligns Windows `fa update` with `install.ps1`, which was already correct since it installs the exe under `<root>\bin\`).
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine.dart`: a dart:ffi library-load failure now degrades to a clean `SQLite is unavailable … reinstall or run fa update` note (`isSqliteDynamicLibraryLoadFailure` + `sqliteUnavailableMessage` in `sqlite_reader.dart`) instead of the raw resolver dump; database-level errors pass through untouched. A Dart-level system-library fallback is not possible with native-assets bindings (build-time asset mapping, no loader override).
- **Successor-side layout self-heal (gh-1574 review)**: on the first failed load, `repairStaleSqliteBundleLayout` moves stale `<exe_dir>/libsqlite3.*` leftovers (the inert `bin/lib` population the pre-fix installers left) into `<exe_dir>/../lib/` and retries the load once — best-effort, never clobbers an existing target file, `libsqlite3.*` names only. The first SQLite read on an updated binary therefore repairs the layout; non-load retry errors pass through untouched.
- Lib copies no longer fail silently: `site/install.sh` and `install_local.sh` warn naming the lib dir instead of `2>/dev/null || true`.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/sqlite3_engine_stub.dart`: constructor parity for the conditional export.
